question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. Select the part that contains a grammatical error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

A tiger be strayed into a village / at Gosaba in the Sundarbans, entered a / cowshed and killed three cows last night.

options.text: at Gosaba in the Sundarbans, entered a
cowshed and killed three cows last night.
A tiger be strayed into a village

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. A tiger be strayed into a village.
